A, B = 0, 1

    if i == 1:
        A = 0
        B = 1
    k = (x * i) // y
    for j in range(11):
        candidate_k = k + j
        diff1 = abs(x * i - y * candidate_k)
        diff2 = abs(x * B - y * A)
        cost1 = diff1 * y * B
        cost2 = diff2 * y * i
        if i == 1 and j == 0:
            A = 0
            B = 1
        if cost1 < cost2:
            A = candidate_k
            B = i

g = gcd(A, B)
print(f"{A // g}/{B // g}")
